name: Teach a short procedure to a novice
short_description: Teach a short procedure to a novice once under stated everyday conditions without assistance.
self_assessment: I can teach a short procedure to a novice in one repeatable attempt without help.
description: Teach a short procedure to a novice means carrying out this capability under ordinary, stated conditions without another person completing any part. Practice focuses on the observable result, the threshold in the self-assessment, and repeatability across more than one occasion. The capability includes selecting an appropriate approach, completing the action, and checking the outcome. It excludes brand-specific steps, credentials, unrelated habits, and one-off achievements.
examples: Teach a short procedure to a novice in a fresh real-life scenario.

builds_on.note: Follow a short written procedure helps develop teach a short procedure to a novice but is not indispensable.
